name: Pax Historia
storyline: There is no set story in Pax Historia, you write your own based on a starting scenario
summary:
Pax Historia is an alternate-history sandbox game where players choose a country, a moment in time, and rewrite the course of history with the help of generative AI. What if Rome never fell? What if the Soviet Union survived? What if Genghis Khan ruled for another generation?

We go beyond history, too. What if aliens invaded Earth? What if you were a college dropout creating a tech startup? The ability to create, edit, and copy custom maps, actors, historical context, and more means that users can play nearly any scenario they can imagine
